name: ordinary-day
about: Two campaigns with leads, a month's spend and two mature cohorts beside a young one.

output.headline: On 2026-11-03, 2 campaigns delivered 7 leads across 14,600 impressions at a combined cost per lead of $40.61.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet was the stronger performer, drawing 6 of the day's 7 leads at $30.75 cost per lead from 9,120 impressions and a 1.5% click rate on $184.50 spent.
Dedicated night runs brought in 1 lead at $99.75 cost per lead — the full day's spend on that campaign — with 5,480 impressions and a 1.1% click rate.
Overall day totals: $284.25 spent, 203 clicks, and a 1.4% click rate across both campaigns.
Month-to-date spend on Meta stands at $612.30 for 2026-11, with 28 days left in the month.
The mature 2026-09-21 cohort shows 38 leads, a contact rate of 86.8%, a hire rate of 10.5%, and 4 hired so far.

The mature 2026-09-28 cohort shows 40 leads, a contact rate of 90.0%, a hire rate of 12.5%, and 5 hired; the 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads with 9 contacted and 1 applied, but it is too young to judge its rates.
